scripts.//lint: --max-warnings ratchets the 14 remaining warnings (3 exhaustive-deps + 11 React-Compiler-readiness, see eslint.config.js) so they cannot grow. Lower the number as they are fixed; do not raise it. Was 25 until MAP-05 deleted useMapbox.ts (8) and MapboxGlobe.tsx (3) — a deletion, not a fix, so the remaining 14 are the same warnings they always were.

//lint-staged: The ts/tsx entry was `bash -c 'npx tsc --noEmit || true'`, so a type error could never fail a commit — that `|| true` is how 110 of them accumulated. The `bash -c` wrapper itself is still needed and is NOT a smell: lint-staged appends the staged filenames to every command, and `tsc --noEmit <files>` silently discards tsconfig.json (no include, no paths, no strict). Passing them as ignored positional args to bash keeps the whole-project check. What changed is that the exit code now propagates.
//overrides: Security overrides, not preferences. GHSA-mh99-v99m-4gvg (brace-expansion DoS) is fixed ONLY in brace-expansion 5.0.8 — the 1.x and 2.x maintenance lines were never patched, so the previous 'brace-expansion@1'/'@2' pins could never clear the advisory. 5.0.8 exports { expand } instead of a callable default, which minimatch <10 cannot consume, so minimatch has to move to 10.x in the same breath. See the Security Audit job in .github/workflows/test.yml for the removal condition.
